'''2013 Alderaan Regionals Roy McCarthy LS Sullust''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Roy McCarthy]] at [[2013 Alderaan Regionals]] (Regionals).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Sullust|DS2-L-sullust.gif}}
* '''Username:''' RybackStun
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Regionals
